description: Renovate only keeps the Bootlin musl toolchains current. Dependabot handles GitHub Actions, NuGet and the .NET SDK; scripts/check-native-updates.sh (check-native-dependencies.yml) handles the bundled compression libraries, including their SHA256 hashes.

customManagers.description: Bootlin stable musl toolchain release used for all three Linux builds

bootlin-toolchains.description: Bootlin x86-64 toolchain tarball listing. All three architectures share the stable release name, so one listing is enough to detect releases.

prBodyNotes: Updates the cross-compilers for all three Linux builds (x86-64, armv7-eabihf, aarch64); CI downloads and builds with each one.
